 Follow Sydney Sweeney Is Hibernation-Ready in Unbuttoned Cardigan & SYRN Knit Pants
 Shweta Chakrawarty Fri, October 23, 2026 at 5:51 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: @sydney_sweeney / Instagram Sydney Sweeney is embracing cozy season in style with the latest installment of SYRN 's "The Holiday Shop" campaign. The actress stars in the newly unveiled "Hibernation Nation" chapter, showcasing a relaxed yet playful aesthetic for her lingerie and loungewear brand. The campaign teases one of four holiday-inspired collections set to launch on October 27 at 8 a.m. PT. It invites fans to sign up for early access before the pieces officially hit the online store.
 Sydney Sweeney enters 'Hibernation Nation' in tiny unbuttoned cardigan and SYRN knit pants
 For the campaign, Sydney Sweeney slips into an ash-blue knitted ensemble from what appears to be SYRN' s "Comfy" collection. The cozy look features a tiny ribbed cardigan worn casually unbuttoned, revealing a matching ash-blue knit bra with delicate lace trim. She paired the top with coordinating high-waisted knit pants that hug her silhouette before falling to an ankle-length finish. The monochromatic set perfectly captures the collection's relaxed, homebody-inspired vibe while blending comfort with feminine details.
 The promotional shoot unfolds in a retro-inspired bathroom, giving the campaign a playful everyday feel. In one standout image, Sweeney poses in front of a mirror with shaving foam around her mouth while holding a razor. Her playful pose adds a humorous twist to the cozy fashion story. Another behind-the-scenes snap shows the actress taking a mirror selfie with her iPhone. She playfully sticks out her tongue while wrapping one arm across her waist.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement A third image, styled with a nostalgic film effect, captures Sweeney smiling confidently with both hands on her hips as she admires her reflection. The vintage-inspired bathroom setting, complete with striped wallpaper and warm lighting, reinforces the campaign's nostalgic holiday atmosphere.
 Keeping the focus on the knitwear, Sweeney opted for soft glam beauty. Her blonde hair was styled in loose, tousled waves. Meanwhile, her makeup featured subtle eyeliner, lightly defined eyes, flushed cheeks, and muted pink lips that complemented the cool blue tones of the outfit.
 With "Hibernation Nation," SYRN leans into effortless comfort for the upcoming drop. The brand proves that cozy loungewear can be just as fashionable as it is functional for the holiday season.
